Interest generated by the Wildcat position is retained at protocol level and redistributed through DEX LP gauges rather than passed through to evaUSDC share price
pegMechanism: ERC-4626 vault with share price held at 1:1 against USDC (totalAssets == totalSupply on the view function, so there is no NAV drift). Redemption burns evaUSDC and returns USDC once the Wildcat withdrawal cycle completes. Peg arbitrage against DEX markets relies on the fixed mint/redeem rate. Cross-chain transport uses the LayerZero OFT standard with deterministic (CREATE2) addresses across Ethereum, Base, Linea, Avalanche, Sonic, and HyperEVM
